title: Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit Reduction for Exceeding Eligible Costs
content:
**Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit (Closing Cost Credit program) — reduction against the Loan Estimate**

Before closing, the part of a verified Hometown Heroes credit's available balance above the costs it can still pay on the latest Loan Estimate is booked as a reduction for exceeding eligible costs, drawing on the credit's first award entry. This reduction comes in addition to the rule that what remains on any credit after every eligible cost is paid at closing is still booked as a reduction for exceeding eligible costs.

A Hometown Heroes credit's reduction against the Loan Estimate is not fixed until the credit's basis stands at the base loan amount now on the loan file. Said the other way round: as long as the credit's basis differs from the base loan amount now on the loan file, the reduction against the Loan Estimate is not fixed.

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Credit | a verified Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit |
| Timing | before closing |
| Measured against | the costs the credit can still pay on the latest Loan Estimate |
| Entry | a reduction for exceeding eligible costs, drawing on the credit's first award entry |

### Situation of use and effect of the tool

`reduce_unusable_credit_facd0be5` books a reduction that takes off a verified closing cost credit the part of its balance the borrower's eligible costs cannot use. One call books one reduction entry with the reason that the credit exceeds the eligible costs, drawing on the named award entry of the same credit, and lowers the credit's available balance by the amount reduced; the reduced amount is never paid to the borrower. Afterwards the credit's ledger shows the reduction entry and the lower available balance.

### How it is invoked

It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `reduce_unusable_credit_facd0be5` and then calls it.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `credit_award_id` | Reference number of the verified closing cost credit being reduced, as shown by the closing credit lookup for the loan file. | An identifier, as shown in the lookup. |
| `source_entry_id` | Reference number of the award entry on this credit's ledger that the reduction draws on, as shown by the credit ledger lookup for the credit. | An identifier, as shown in the lookup. |
| `entry_amount` | Amount taken off the credit. | US dollars as a plain positive number with exactly 2 decimal places (cents), no currency sign or thousands separators; stored as given, rounded to 2 decimal places. |

### Return

> Reduction <entry_id> booked: <amount> taken off credit <credit_award_id> as exceeding eligible costs; available balance <balance>.

<entry_id> is the reference number of the new reduction entry; <amount> and <balance> are US dollars with 2 decimals. Receiving this line means the reduction is on the credit's ledger; the call has succeeded when the receipt is returned.
